clues.missing: A community organizer has disappeared after an argument about public disclosure.
clues.roster: A public event register links two rival political groups to the same evening meeting.
clues.witness: A witness heard a heated argument but cannot identify who was responsible.
clues.message: A recovered voluntary message asks for privacy, but its sender cannot be authenticated.

hypotheses.text: Two rival organizations may be connected by the same event, not necessarily by conspiracy.
The alleged disappearance could be voluntary, coercive, or staged. Evidence is incomplete.

briefing.title: Helsinki, 2045 | Europol briefing
briefing.text: Etsivä Romppainen receives a case involving a missing organizer and competing political groups. The initial report is mundane; grand theories can wait. This is a NONCANONICAL development case.

choices.label: Read the missing-person report and public event register
Interview a witness from the meeting

records.title: Records desk
records.text: The event register confirms attendance, not guilt. Both groups publicly disagree about AI oversight and disputed disclosure claims.

witness.title: Witness interview
witness.text: The witness remembers raised voices. They cannot say whether the missing organizer left willingly.

message.title: The message
message.text: The message requests that the sender's location remain private. Its authenticity is unresolved; making it public could endanger someone.

choices.label: Review all leads and decide how to proceed

decision.title: Case assessment
decision.text: The missing-person report, event register, witness testimony and disputed message are now in the notebook. You have evidence of disagreement, not proof of a crime.

choices.label: Protect the person's privacy and refer for safeguarding verification
Seek formal review and preserve the evidence without public accusations
Publish the uncertain links and risk damaging innocent people

private_end.title: Provisional closure: privacy first
private_end.text: Romppainen records the unresolved questions and requests a confidential welfare check. The public case remains unproven.

review_end.title: Provisional closure: formal review
review_end.text: Romppainen preserves the evidence and sends it for independent verification. No one has been convicted by an association graph.

public_end.title: Provisional closure: premature disclosure
public_end.text: The public release escalates the conflict. A possible lead is gained at the cost of trust. The case remains factually unresolved.

contradictions.text: The witness remembers raised voices; the message reads calm and procedural. One of the two accounts is incomplete.

deductions.text: The organizer is absent from an event they organised. Absence is a fact; its reason is not.
The tone of the message does not match the witness's memory. Either the message is not from that evening, or the witness is recalling a different meeting.
